attacker_pocs.name: hashed_salt_boundary
attacker_pocs.why: A hashed known-hosts entry with a 32-character base64 salt passes the revised length check. knownhost_line_hashed copies all 32 bytes into saltbuf and writes its terminator one byte beyond the stack array.

role_a_rationale: The OpenSSL cipher path now validates block lengths and allocates output storage for AES-GCM segments larger than the fixed buffer; a 64-byte GCM round trip and the available CTest case pass. The known-hosts salt limit change appears to widen accepted hashed-host input, but admits a salt exactly as long as its stack buffer and leaves no room for the terminating byte. The public known-hosts PoC exits normally on the parent and aborts with ASan on the patched tree.
